findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: http_inspect, url_metadata, robots_check, qr_payment_link, html_to_markdown, json_repair, webhook_inbox_create, webhook_inbox_read · Private data: token_safety_check, ens_resolve, gas_compare, allowance_revoke_plan, tx_explain, calldata_decode, qr_payment_link, nft_metadata, abi_encode, token_balances, erc4626_vault, og_image_check, spf_dmarc_check, ip_owner, jwt_inspect, yaml_json_convert, text_stats, ip_cidr, password_strength, token_count, llm_cost_estimate, text_chunk, html_to_markdown, prompt_injection_scan, mime_sniff, hmac_verify, mcp_token_measure, moneytools_trends_detail, webhook_inbox_create · Public sink: ens_resolve, erc4626_vault, prompt_injection_scan, hmac_verify, webhook_inbox_create, webhook_inbox_read · Destructive: cron_next_runs, security_headers_audit, llms_txt_validate, regex_test, json_format, iban_validate, math_eval, partner_program_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: http_inspect, url_metadata, robots_check, qr_payment_link, html_to_markdown, json_repair, webhook_inbox_create, webhook_inbox_read · Private data: token_safety_check, ens_resolve, gas_compare, allowance_revoke_plan, tx_explain, calldata_decode, qr_payment_link, nft_metadata, abi_encode, token_balances, erc4626_vault, og_image_check, spf_dmarc_check, ip_owner, jwt_inspect, yaml_json_convert, text_stats, ip_cidr, password_strength, token_count, llm_cost_estimate, text_chunk, html_to_markdown, prompt_injection_scan, mime_sniff, hmac_verify, mcp_token_measure, moneytools_trends_detail, webhook_inbox_create · Public sink: ens_resolve, erc4626_vault, prompt_injection_scan, hmac_verify, webhook_inbox_create, webhook_inbox_read · Destructive: cron_next_runs, security_headers_audit, llms_txt_validate, regex_test, json_format, iban_validate, math_eval, partner_program_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
